title: Author a learning path
summary: Turn a skill you know into a step-by-step course for node bin/app learn: write the path, link the documentation, define win conditions and validate it with learn check.
audience: Contributors who completed a wizard and want to teach a workflow of this repository

steps.title: Read the learning path format
steps.goal: Know the parts of a step and how win conditions decide completion.

checklist.label: I read the win condition reference

steps.title: Plan your learning path
steps.goal: Choose the id and the skill of your course.

fields.label: Learning path id (lowercase kebab-case, e.g. run-first-run)

steps.title: Write and check your path
steps.goal: Write a path with at least one step and a win condition, and make learn check pass.
steps.markdown: Create `configs/learning/paths/<your path id>.json`, then run `learn check` until it reports no issues. Start from [[docs/development/LEARNING-PATHS#A minimal path]].
